Title: Predicting the Role of Political Trolls in Social Media
3 Method Given a set of known political troll users (each user being represented as a collection of their tweets), we aim to detect their role: left, right, or news feed. Title: Predicting the Role of Political Trolls in Social Media

The contributions of this paper can be summa- rized as follows: • We predict the political role of Internet trolls (left, news feed, right) in a realistic, unsuper- vised scenario, where labels for the trolls are not available, and which has not been explored in the literature before.

[3] Source: 1910.02001.pdf | Page: 1 | Section: None
Title: Predicting the Role of Political Trolls in Social Media
